record.name: Saber Reflect

universal_access.description: Iconic lightsaber defense technique available to any Force-sensitive

record.narrative: You intercept incoming blaster fire with your lightsaber, the blade's energy field deflecting bolts harmlessly away or back toward attackers. The power manifests as brilliant flashes where plasma meets plasma, your weapon becoming a shield of light that turns ranged attacks into ineffective light shows.

manifestation.description: precise lightsaber positioning to intercept bolts
using the Force to predict trajectory and timing

base_effect.description: You use your lightsaber to deflect ranged weapon attacks.

mechanics.notes: Reduce ranged attack damage, potentially deflecting attack entirely

class_synergies.narrative: The Guardian's defensive mastery makes Saber Reflect near-perfect protection. They've trained deflection until it's muscle memory—blaster bolts bouncing off their blade without conscious thought, defense so complete it looks effortless.

mechanical_benefit.notes: Guardians can reflect attacks back at the shooter, dealing reflected damage.

species_synergies.narrative: Human adaptability allows them to deflect attacks from unconventional angles and unexpected sources. They've learned to reflect not just blaster bolts but slugthrower rounds, arrows, even thrown weapons through innovative technique.

mechanical_benefit.notes: Humans can deflect any ranged attack, not just energy weapons.

faction_synergies.narrative: The Jedi Order teaches Saber Reflect as fundamental lightsaber technique—the iconic defense that defines Jedi combat. Their methods emphasize calm precision, letting the Force guide deflection for perfect interception.

mechanical_benefit.notes: Jedi can deflect attacks toward chosen targets (attack roll using Force mod).

llm_guidance.roleplay_guidance: Describe the lightsaber intercepting blaster bolts in brilliant flashes, plasma on plasma creating light shows. Show the defender's calm focus, blade moving with preternatural precision to catch every shot. The deflection should feel iconic and effortless.
llm_guidance.tactical_notes: Saber Reflect reduces ranged attack damage as a reaction, potentially negating it entirely. Essential defensive technique for lightsaber users. Uses your reaction but provides excellent protection against ranged threats. Requires wielding a lightsaber.
narrative_hooks: Perfect deflection saves allies from a deadly barrage
The technique reveals Force sensitivity to witnesses
Reflecting a bolt back kills the shooter, creating moral complexity
